verdict.why: First deploys now check for and prompt to register a workers.dev subdomain before uploading.

draft.detail: On a first deploy to an account with no workers.dev subdomain, wrangler now checks for a workers.dev subdomain before uploading the Worker

test.error: FAIL: wrangler deploy uploaded the new Worker before checking for a workers.dev subdomain

source.quote: Deploying a Worker for the first time on an account that has no workers.dev subdomain failed with an opaque API error raised by the upload request itself (code 10063, "You need a workers.dev subdomain in order to proceed"). Wrangler now checks for a workers.dev subdomain before uploading
